title: 白瓷茶气
style: handpainted yellow-glazed porcelain, cobalt accent details, pale tea-room tabletop
beats: A tiny white porcelain teacup rests before the face
Orange steam curls rise from the cup
Three steam curls become a floating crown
The face bows and the crown tilts
The curls flow back into the cup
The teacup rests still and the face returns upright
